notes.title: Dev Server: New Player Experience Class Overhaul
notes.content: [h2]September 20th[/h2][p]All characters from Live have been copied over to QA from September 20th @6pm central.[/p][list][*][p]Increased emissions on Central Ibaxus Greater Relic Scepters and Shields.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased respawn rate of cave bears in Newhaven Valley.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted VFX from Mandrake poison VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Warden's Venom Strike Alchemy I no longer snares the target. It now receives a damage increase.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the base effectiveness of the Warden's Snare ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing levels of Brigand Stun Alchemy.[/p][/*][*][p]Knight's receive Order of the Tribune starting at level 3. This order has increased threat on auto attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased text size for class descriptions on creation and class selection dialog.[/p][/*][*][p]Added audio to Ashen spawn & death VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with default chat settings not being present.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare bug that could cause duplicate scenes to load from character selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an EV tutorial popup.[/p][/*][*][p]Alchemy Quest update:[/p][list][*][p]If the quest is started at Banton in the Academy then you must first find the bag of Ember Stones in the Crawling Burrows before other objectives are available.[/p][/*][*][p]If you go to the bag of Ember Stones first then that will also start the quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Interacting with the bag of Ember Stones in the EV will grant you your first Ember Stone. This will allow you to naturally fill your stone as you proceed with the Alchemy quest (as it was previously). [/p][/*][*][p]This new flow should also resolve an issue with the UI not updating when completing the quest.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]September 19th[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug causing abilities in the skills UI to move around if they were moved on your action bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing material on Ember Stones inside of the bag in the Crawling Burrows.[/p][/*][*][p]Added audio to player teleport and Other dissolve VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Trim role descriptions on character creation and the select class dialog.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Ashen spawn and death VFX (still WIP).[/p][/*][*][p]Updated VFX for ant abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated a number of NPC defensive ability VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Order of Iron VFX.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]September 18th[/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted spawn & death Ashen VFX (still WIP).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted VFX for Shifting Strike.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up some ability animations that weren't showing with a bow.[/p][/*][*][p]Alchemy quest no longer has level requirements. Alchemy can be acquired at any level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Alchemy quest starting clickable in Crawling Burrows EV.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed new characters starting with 2 separate stacks of smelling salts.[/p][/*][*][p]Weaken Alchemy 2 no longer stacks with Dread Tone.[/p][/*][*][p]Dread Tone Alchemy 2 additionally extends duration of the effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Ibaxian Runestone descriptions for runes that now have full effect on outer armor.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]September 17th[/h2][p]All characters from Live have been copied over to QA from September 17 @10am central.[/p][list][*][p]Increased damage reduction on Dread Tone (ability balance is still in flux based on recent feedback)[/p][/*][*][p]Ibaxian Adornment Outer Armor pieces now consider all resist runes to give their full effect (Rune tooltip not updated yet).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where Movement Resists were being added twice for Ibaxian Adornment outer armor.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced potency of abilities from Corduun Seekers and Excavators in Ibaxus.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Central Ibaxus weapons (Greater Ibaxian Relics) to have enhanced emissions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue that was preventing characters from getting their class skills if they had not picked a spec yet.[/p][/*][*][p]Added VFX when a player teleports somewhere via Monolith or Ley Link (WIP).[/p][/*][*][p]Added VFX to Ashen creature spawns and deaths (WIP).[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled depth-of-field effect on character select screen. Hoping this reduces GPU chugging here.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted class description flyout sizes and positions.[/p][/*][*][p]Trimmed class descriptions (WIP).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]September 16th[/h2][p]All characters from Live have been copied over to QA from September 16 @10am central. This means that newbie characters from the previous week of QA are no longer with us - thank you for testing![/p][p]With this test we have the following focus items:[/p][list][*][p]Characters without a base role or specialization will be required to select a class before they can login. You will see a button "Select Class" on the nameplate, which will bring up a new dialog with your selection options.[/p][list][*][p]With no base class you can select from all 9 available classes and will start at level 1.[/p][/*][*][p]With a base role but no spec you will be able to choose from the 3 subclasses of your base role. If you are below level 6 then your class level will match your current level. If you are above level 6, then your class level will be set to level 6 and will need to play catch up.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]On first login for all other characters they will undergo a "live migration" process which will add, remove, and replace skills depending on your specific class configuration.[/p][list][*][p]For QA we ask that you verify that you are not missing any skills and the migration (as outlined in previous notes from below) went through as expected.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Other changes:[/p][list][*][p]Updated dialogs for various trainers, Beardin, and the Alchemy quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced emission on Retaliate VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Others now play a dissolve-like VFX when they vanish.[/p][/*][*][p]Adornment layer visuals can now be toggled on/off via context menu option when right clicking the Adornment tab.[/p][/*][*][p]GEL now uses the player's actual level for XP calculations for mobs yellow and below (actual chevron color). Orange & Red uses the GEL level (GEL icon color). This is basically "the best of both world" in the sense that it uses a mix of the old method and the newer method.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Warlord starting look - now have gloves instead of a single vambrace.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Dread Tone range to match Heavy Crossbow range.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected stamina cost for Order of Iron at higher levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent multiple sources of Dread Tone from stacking.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue preventing Dread Tone from listing details in the tooltip.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue preventing Alchemy Order of Iron from triggering from Ripostes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue while shaping Central Ibaxian Relics that was causing the wrong Relic to be considered for setting Class Requirements to equip.[/p][/*][*][p]Central Ibaxus Shaped Relics should more consistently inherit stats from the supplied Lower Ibaxus Shaped Relics.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated various Ant ability VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing stats on Central Ibaxus Juggernaut Curved Sword Relic.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]September 12th[/h2][list][*][p]Re-enabling zoom slider on character creation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the macro bar window to properly include the + button so that it cannot be moved off screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typo on Hardtack.[/p][/*][*][p]Auction House duration now correctly shows "Days" on QA.[/p][/*][*][p]Beardin now accepts any type of diseased hide.[/p][/*][*][p]Order of Iron now bypasses active defenses.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Alchemy for Impact.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Alchemy for Dread Tone and adjusted range.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Dread Tone, removing the Damage over Time component and adding a Damage Debuff on the target.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted stamina on Order of Iron[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]September 11th[/h2][list][*][p]Reduced healing amount of worker ants in Crawling Burrows EV[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced number of Glyph Ants that spawn outside of Crawling Burrows EV[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced social aggro range of ants that spawn outside of Crawling Burrows EV[/p][/*][*][p]Further increased spawn chance of Frenzied mobs in newbie area.[/p][/*][*][p]Followup quest rewards for Ember Essence updated to be low level potions.[/p][/*][*][p]Brigand ability Shifting Strike limited to increase positional bonus for the next two attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Disciples of Ruto in Ibaxus have had their Energy Leech ability reduced and the self-haste component removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Further reduced respawn rate for Fishing Village and Stonecoat Camp in Grimstone Canyon[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some environmental issues in Grimstone Canyon.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Alchemy and Alchemy descriptions for new abilities (still WIP)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Alchemy not being available after completing the Alchemy quest at level 6.[/p][/*][*][p]Other misc Alchemy quest fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]September 10th[/h2][list][*][p]Alchemy Quest updated for the new level 5 EV. The quest can be started the normal way (talking to the NPC in the academy) or via a clickable just inside of the EV.  Note that we have not yet tested these changes internally, so have at it and make sure to /report any bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an exception that could cause Steam transactions to not finalize.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Login with Steam tooltip not showing when Steam could not initialize.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled Archie and corresponding quest clickables in Meadowlands.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed spelling issues in some quests involving the Grotto.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some stuck spots in Ibaxus and Grizzled Peaks.[/p][/*][*][p]More fixes to Noble Elk recipes.[/p][/*][*][p]Lake bears in ML are now 1^.[/p][/*][*][p]World boss death announcements are now funneled to the emote channel.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option toggle to disable world boss death announcements.[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled seasonable scene to celebrate the 3rd anniversary of the launch of Embers Adrift.[/p][/*][*][p]Re-enabled turnip heads on humanoid NPCs both to wear, and as drops.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated VFX and animations on new skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Wayward Mangrove is now bigger.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a Staff/Polearm animation that was failing to play.[/p][/*][*][p]Warlord's Dread Tone now scales with weapon damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Knight's Order of Iron now scales with weapon damage, only triggers on auto attacks, and has had the base damage increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Juggernaut's Alchemy for Breach has removed mention of "Momentum" to avoid confusion with the new skill.[/p][/*][*][p]Marshal:[/p][list][*][p]Concussive Strike has been replaced with the original Threatening Strike. In order to see this change you will have to re-create a Marshal[/p][/*][*][p]While the daze was a good fit for the Marshal's kit, replacing their most used ability for damage/threat with an ability which might be held for CC purposes caused too much conflict. As Threatening Strike is no longer a shared generic role ability it was an easy choice to maintain playability and balance.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Sentinel[/p][list][*][p]Blinding Strike now deals additional armor damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Guarding Strike is now obtained at level 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Guarding Strike cooldown has been reduced to 20 seconds, resists now only benefit the Sentinel directly and lasts for 20 seconds or 2 hits.[/p][/*][*][p]Restoration is now obtained at level 8.[/p][/*][*][p]Resuscitation Alchemy II is now usable on non-unconscious targets.[/p][/*][*][p]Has an additional 5 armor weight that it receives starting at level 1.[/p][/*][*][p]This class has been falling behind other classes with pacing. The above changes addresses a few concerns, such as getting 2 heal abilities back-to-back. Their early game solo kill speed, and doubling down on their class identity as a defensively minded supporter.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]September 8th[/h2][p]We would like to invite the community to comment, test, and provide feedback on our upcoming changes to the new player experience which focuses on initial class selection, class identity, changes to Newhaven Valley content, pacing and balance. [/p][p][/p][p]Given the focus of this test we are settings things up on the dev server a little differently:[/p][list][*][p]The QA server is a blank slate. You will have to create a new character for testing. [/p][/*][*][p]Your shared storage and the auction house will be empty.[/p][/*][*][p]All Steam logins are considered a subscriber so that you can create 9 characters.[/p][/*][*][p]The only zones currently online are: Newhaven Valley, Newhaven City, Northreach, Central Veins 1+2, and any Ember Vein accessible from NHV & Northreach.[/p][/*][*][p]The QA zone is offline.[/p][/*][*][p]At a later date we will bring over data from Live so that you can all test character migrations (ability changes, players without a spec selecting a class, etc).[/p][/*][/list][p]Please join us in our [url="https://discord.com/channels/168028734039916544/1075841004449579128"]#qa-chat discord channel[/url] to discuss and provide feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Note that for new/changed abilities the Animation/VFX and Alchemy versions are not all finished yet.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Intent of Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]We want to bring the flavor of each class more immediately to the game and reduce the presence of generic role abilities, each character should immediately feel and look unique.[/p][/*][*][p]We want to bring the excitement of Alchemy, and the bizarre nature of Ember, Ruptures and Ember Veins closer to the start of the game to make sure players get an early taste of the unique fantasy the game has.[/p][/*][*][p]We are taking extra care to try and align with new player expectations in regards to what a class' role and fantasy is within the world.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Character changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Characters now start with different equipped weapons and armor based on class selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Removal of the Base Roles, characters select their Class (previously specialization) during character creation.[/p][/*][*][p]Rearrange skill grant order to prioritize early game class feel and fantasy.[/p][list][*][p]For example Brigands starting with Stun[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Earlier access to Emberstone and Alchemy:[/p][list][*][p]Emberstone will now be part of the reward for the Alchemy unlock quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Alchemy unlock quest is being revamped for NHV. This step is not yet complete and unavailable for testing.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]A few generic role abilities have been replaced with more thematic class abilities.[/p][list][*][p]Bleeding Strike for Strikers has been replaced by...[/p][list][*][p]Berserkers gain a new ability "Impact" which is a slow, but inexpensive 2x weapon damage attack[/p][/*][*][p]Brigands gain a new ability "Shifting Strike" which in addition to dealing damage, gives the Brigand a strong +Positional buff for a period of Time[/p][/*][*][p]Wardens gain a new ability "Snare" which in addition to dealing damage slows their target's movement.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Assailing Strike for Supporters (except Duelist) has been replaced by...[/p][list][*][p]Duelists keep Assailing Strike making armor damage core to their offensive style[/p][/*][*][p]Warlords gain a new ability "Dread Tone" which deals damage, armor damage and has a dot effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Sentinels again a new ability "Guarding Strike" which deals damage, armor damage, and reduces damage to their defensive target[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Threatening Strike for Defenders has been replaces by...[/p][list][*][p][strike]Marshals gain a new ability "Concussive Strike" which is a fast attacking ability with a short Daze which can be used to interrupt mob abilities[/strike] (see September 10th above)[/p][/*][*][p]Knights gain a new ability "Order of Iron" that deals additional damage on each hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Juggernauts gain a new ability "Momentum" which deals damage and gives a stacking +dmg buff, this buff stacks up to 5 times.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Various theming elements of each class have been adjusted, such as icons and descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Sentinel's have had many of their abilities renamed to focus on a stronger theme and class identity[/p][list][*][p]Replenish -> Restoration[/p][/*][*][p]Distracting Strike -> Blinding Strike[/p][/*][*][p]Overprovision -> Night Watch[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]In addition to the skill replacements above many skills have been brought down to lower levels changing which abilities classes all start with. Everyone gets Strike and the following:[/p][list][*][p]Strikers:[/p][list][*][p]Berserker starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Impact[/p][/*][*][p]Assault[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Brigand starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Shifting Strike[/p][/*][*][p]Stun[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Warden starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Venom Strike[/p][/*][*][p]Quillback Spines[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Supporters:[/p][list][*][p]Duelist starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Combined Strike[/p][/*][*][p]Assailing Strike[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Warlord starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Dread Tone[/p][/*][*][p]Rejuvenating Hymn[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Sentinel starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Blinding Strike (previously named Distracting Strike)[/p][/*][*][p]Restoration (previously named Replenish)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Defenders:[/p][list][*][p]Juggernaut starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Momentum[/p][/*][*][p]Breach[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Knight starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Enraging Strike[/p][/*][*][p]Order of Iron[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Marshal starts with:[/p][list][*][p][strike]Concussive Strike[/strike] (see September 10th above)[/p][/*][*][p]Halt[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Additional Balance changes[/p][list][*][p]Increased damage on Halt, Halt by default no longer disables auto attack, Halt now also has additional hit triggers before being removed by default.[/p][/*][*][p]Juggernaut Roar base ability no longer gives a +dmg increase (this has moved into Momentum).[/p][/*][*][p]Warden Assist has moved up to level 30 in order to bring Quillback Spines down to a lower level.[/p][list][*][p]Assist now grants the entire group Advantage for a duration instead of just your defensive target.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Content Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Most Newhaven Valley camps have been reduced to 1^ in difficulty, the Ancient Bear camp remains 3^.[/p][/*][*][p]Regular named (excludes Misha and Knave of Harts) in Newhaven Valley have been reduced to 2^ in difficulty, but rewards remain the same.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased frequency of Frenzied mobs to show up near the newbie area.[/p][/*][*][p]The Crawling Burrows EV has moved from Dryfoot into Newhaven Valley, the content and rewards within have been updated to reflect the lower level (~lvl 5).[/p][/*][*][p]Wayward Mangrove has been brought closer to newbie area, while it is non-aggressive it does assist the Mandrakes if you are not mindful.[/p][/*][*][p]Meadowlands Lake Brown Bears have been reduced to 1^ in difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced daze duration on Ibaxian Slagjacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Crusader Arribac's adds no longer share a respawn timer.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]System Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Player Damage Resists now impact damage over time abilities per-tick damage calculations.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed Noble Elk Recipes incorrectly requiring level 25[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue preventing Ibaxian Recipe chests from spawning in Central Ibaxus[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Monthly Patch: August 2025
notes.content: [p]This month's patch has a number of QoL improvements, bug fixes, and design adjustments. [/p][p]IL2CPP is now the default build configuration (detailed [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3336530/partnerevents/edit/510712822654566617"]here[/url]). For those of you who were running the [i]live_il2cpp[/i] branch you will need to revert back to [i]None[/i] to get the most up to date client built with IL2CPP tech.[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed stuck spots in Newhaven Valley, Northreach, Dryfoot, Highland Hills, Redshore, Redshore Ridge, Grizzled Peaks, and Ibaxus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with Berserker Assault animations sometimes not playing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed initialization issues with friend & guild lists + show offline button.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with input fields locking character movement after a window was closed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Added dithering effect to most vegetation when the camera is in close proximity.[/p][/*][*][p]Added arguments to the [i]/played[/i] command. You can now do "/played all" to show total played time for all characters on your account. In addition, you can specify another character on your account to get the played time for that specific character (i.e. "/played drindin"). Supplying no arguments (just [i]/played)[/i] will function as it did previously.[/p][/*][*][p]UI:[/p][list][*][p]Added specific loading tips to some loading images regarding those images.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a confirmation dialog when deploying a portable crafting station while missing your bag.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a confirmation dialog when attempting to apply a consumable when that consumable's effect is already applied.[/p][/*][*][p]Escape now closes confirmation dialogs.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Can Use" toggle to merchant windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Chat window:[/p][list][*][p]Revamped the saving & loading procedure for chat windows so that they are more reliable.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "/resetchatwindows" chat command to reset all chat windows to the default layout of 1x chat and 1x combat window in the bottom right of your screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Healing" filter to combat tabs.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Note: if you run into any issues we recommend running the above reset command for a fresh configuration.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Loot window:[/p][list][*][p]Added a Loot All button.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Loot All keybind (unbound by default).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Map window:[/p][list][*][p]Can now be resized to be slightly larger, or considerably smaller.[/p][/*][*][p]The aspect ratio of this window is locked to prevent scaling issues with the map. Keep in mind that this behavior is a bit different than other resizable windows (like the chat window).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Auction House [i]Buy It Now[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Now shows a reduced price when you are the current highest bidder. The total cost remains unchanged. However, if you are the highest bidder you can now pay the difference between your bid and the buy it now amount.[/p][/*][*][p]A "lower buy it now" indicator has been added when this is in effect - the tooltip shows the original price.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Design:[/p][list][*][p]Increased 3^ mob experience reward by 20%.[/p][/*][*][p]Slowed respawn rate of Stonecoat + Drolsc camp in Grimstone Canyon.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased spawn chance for Blightroot and Deeproot Mandrakes/Mangroves within Blightroot Grove.[/p][/*][*][p]Stricter leashes on mobs within Shrieking Barrows to reduce the chances of 2^ mobs wandering into the 1^ loop.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased leash range on Freehold mobs that were resetting too quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Most Smuggler camps in Newhaven Valley reduced to 1^ camps.[/p][/*][*][p]Wayward Mangrove path moved to the newbie area in NHV.[/p][/*][*][p]Mandrakes now spawn in the newbie area in NHV.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased threat for Knight's Bash, Marshal's Pressure & Sweep.[/p][/*][*][p]Warlord ability Despair alchemy versions now additional enhance the healing reduction debuff.[/p][/*][*][p]Quarterstaff of the Glacier stats changed to more Supporter focused stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Stags, Does, and Elks now have a chance to drop Tea leaves as loot (they still drop from skinning).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ibaxus:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue which was preventing Supporter Outer Armor from receiving haste from runes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing Mandrakes from being hostile.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing set bonus on Greater Ibaxian inner armor Adornments.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the amount of Resin required for Ibaxian Adornment/Relic reconstruction.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the cost of Resin.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced armor requirements for fighting in Central Ibaxus.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Ibaxian Shard drop counts.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased stat values provided by Greater Ibaxian Runes.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased armor on Inner Armor Adornments by a small amount.[/p][/*][*][p]Added stats to Defender Outer Armor Adornments. These continue the flavor of bonuses from GP1 armors.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more diversity to crab types.[/p][/*][*][p]Crabs in Ibaxus are now more social.[/p][/*][*][p]Greater Ibaxian Adornments/Relics now require a Shaped Ibaxian Adornment/Relic as part of the Artificing recipe. Note that the item is consumed in the process.[/p][/*][*][p]Greater Ibaxian Runes sell for slightly more than their lesser versions.[/p][/*][*][p]Ibaxian Ashen are now correctly resistant to Alchemy Effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Cor'duun Sentries no longer drop Runes or Artifacts.[/p][/*][*][p]Cor'duun now drop coin.[/p][/*][*][p]3^ mobs have an increased chance to drop runes and artifacts.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]GEL Experience Adjustments[/h3][p]When you group with other players, our [b]Group Elevated Level (GEL)[/b] system helps lower-level players keep up with their higher-level group mates. GEL temporarily raises your effective combat level (up to +5 higher than your adventuring level) so that you can better land hits and contribute against more difficult enemies.[/p][p][/p][p]Previously, experience rewards while GEL'd were calculated based on your real level. This ultimately led to lower-level players getting poor experience returns when compared to other activities. With this month's update, experience rewards will now be calculated using your GEL level when comparing against the enemy's level. That means your experience gains will better match the challenge of what your group is fighting. Here is a practical example:[/p][p][/p][p][i]Before (old system):[/i][/p][list][*][p]Drindin (level 20) groups with Undone (level 26).[/p][/*][*][p]GEL raises Drindin's effective combat level to 25.[/p][/*][*][p]They defeat a level 27 NPC.[/p][/*][*][p]Drindin's is effective in combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Drindin experience reward is calculated based on a level delta of +7, which results in diminished experience as if the NPC was level 17 (light blue). (note that experience for level deltas of +3/+4/+5/... is diminished)[/p][/*][/list][p][i]After (new system):[/i][/p][list][*][p]Same scenario: Drindin (level 20) + Undone (level 26).[/p][/*][*][p]GEL raises Drindin's effective combat level to 25.[/p][/*][*][p]They defeat a level 27 NPC.[/p][/*][*][p]Drindin is still effective in combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Drindin's experience reward is calculated based on a level delta of +2, which results in non-diminished experience as if the NPC was level 22 (yellow).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We fully recognize that this doesn't solve all of our problems, but we believe it is a step in the right direction. It is also worth noting that while this is not exactly a "catch up" mechanic, lower level players should progress through their level at a faster pace than their higher level group mates. This is because higher levels require more kills to progress when compared to lower levels.[/p][p][/p][h3]Next Month[/h3][p]We're working hard on revamping the new player experience for next month's patch. The plan is to start players off with a specialization and allow them to acquire their Ember Stone + Alchemy at level 6. Please stay tuned as we will need some heavy QA testing. [/p][p]Also note that next month's patch will come a week earlier on September 23rd![/p]

notes.title: Monthly Patch: July 2025
notes.content: [p]This month introduces a slew of improvements, QoL updates, and a new performance branch (IL2CPP) for further testing.[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed issues with resources that were spawning under water.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed item category on Mangrove Logs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Radiant Flux crafted weapons not showing their updated visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Cooked Tough Meat recipe output.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that allowed some ranged NPC abilities to be parried and riposted by players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed characters not being clickable on character selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tooltip typo in high resolution sun shadows option.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed macro edit dialog text not wrapping.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual issue with the Log UI when opening/closing the window with the hunting log selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with macOS performance when "None" was selected for the framerate limiter.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lights disabling in the Shaper hallway.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that was causing overhead chat bubble text to be faded.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a spelling error on level 50 dropped tar flasks.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted LOD on a number of weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted LOD on all Ember Ring vegetation.[/p][/*][*][p]Doubled the AFK boot timer for active subscribers.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of bears that spawn for Hallick's Tower quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Rotated seasonal wares on Marta.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the entrance to Freehold to be more solo-friendly.[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the damage over time component on Ashen Boar's Impale ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced rate that NPCs can use the Patch ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Redmane Stalkers should no longer attack boars.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bulletin Board Tasks:[/p][list][*][p]Allow Flooded Ruins Crocodiles and Rats to be counted for the Redshore tasks.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Elk count for Grimstone Canyon task. Included general animal killing as part of the task.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Camera:[/p][list][*][p]Allow left mouse to rotate the camera without rotating the player in over-the-shoulder camera mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted upper camera orbit to be equidistant from the center and lower orbits so that a fixed zoom maintains the same distance for the character in 3rd person camera mode.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]UI:[/p][list][*][p]We have spruced up our loading screens by including various renders of our custom creatures & props that correspond to the region you are currently loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Added title to the offensive UI-space nameplate.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Use Alternate Difficulty Colors" toggle to the interface options to replace the Yellow/Orange/Red difficulty colors with Gold/Red-Orange/Purple.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Type" dropdown to the Auction House which allows you to filter by different types (weapon types, armor types, jewelry, etc).[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Type" to the sort menu in the Auction House which sorts by the above types.[/p][/*][*][p]Auctions that have bids can no longer be cancelled.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the error wording when your client cannot contact Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability UI elements now properly use Alchemy execution and targeting parameters when Alchemy is toggled on.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed "Sale Price" to "Sell Price" on item tooltips at the merchant.[/p][/*][*][p]Max craft count increased from 99 to 999.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Overhead Combat Text:[/p][list][*][p]Now scales with distance to the camera. This should make it easier to see for ranged attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Now properly renders with dynamic resolution modes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ibaxus:[/p][list][*][p]Improved notification of mobs calling allies from great distances.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased delay for certain mobs calling allies from great distances.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased variability in Stalker respawns.[/p][/*][*][p]Enforced stricter reset distances for some mobs.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted a number of nav links around the lake to reduce mobs from climbing the rocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Archibald no longer accepts money from your bank.[/p][/*][*][p]Shards no longer ask for confirmation during Need/Greed loot rolls.[/p][/*][*][p]With the recent slew of activity in Ibaxus the path from the Ember Ring to the valley has become well travelled.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Renamed a few reagents to reserve the "Potent" adjective for the highest level reagent item category:[/p][list][*][p]Potent Venom -> Strong Venom[/p][/*][*][p]Potent Ichor -> Concentrated Ichor[/p][/*][*][p]Potent Salve -> Soothing Salve[/p][/*][*][p]Potent Tincture -> Concentrated Tincture[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]MacOS builds are no longer universal binaries and will only work on Apple Silicon.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the default max shadow casting lights option to 2 (performance optimization).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Optimizations[/h2][h3]Engine and Shader Updates[/h3][p]This patch includes a Unity Engine update to the latest subversion. This brings some small performance improvements and bug fixes. In addition, all vegetation and custom shaders have been updated which should also yield some minor performance gains.[/p][p][/p][h3]Terrain Rendering Optimizations[/h3][p]This month we are adding new culling tech to overland scenes. Most zones are composed of 4 large terrains in a 2x2 configuration. Each individual terrain has a performance setting that was previously set to a fixed number. With this patch we are now dynamically adjusting this value based on your distance to each individual terrain - which should provide a small break to your GPU.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, we have enabled stochastic texture sampling in terrain shaders for all outdoor zones. This rendering technique should reduce the frequency of repeated texture patterns.[/p][p][/p][h3]Application Startup Optimizations[/h3][p]The last few patches have ballooned our application load times to an unacceptable level. On application start we are pre-loading a lot of data which can cause the client to show as "not responding". To mitigate this issue we have deferred some loading until the first loading screen is shown. This means that your first "zone in" after application startup may take slightly longer than it did previously, but subsequent zone loads will be quicker.[/p][p][/p][h3]UI Performance Optimizations[/h3][p]During a deep dive into performance of the game we identified an an issue with how our UI windows interact with Unity's backend UGUI system.[/p][p]Previously, all hidden windows have an alpha value of 0 and are not raycasted against, which means that they cannot be seen or interacted with. When a window is shown, we transition the alpha from 0->1 for a fade in, and enable racyasting for interactions. As it turns out, even though a UI element is not being rendered or raycasted against we were still paying a performance overhead in UGUI to keep them registered and available.[/p][p]This patch changes how we handle hidden windows within our UI system. Once hidden, a window's game object is now completely [i]disabled[/i] which removes them from the UIGUI system entirely. The downside to this, is that there is a slight performance hit for disabling and enabling objects (which is why we did not do it previously). However, this performance hit only lasts a single frame on open/close rather than us paying for having it registered with UGUI on [i]every[/i] frame.[/p][p]We have done a fair bit of internal testing and everything appears to work as usual. In theory this change should not even be noticed - outside of the performance improvement. On average I was saving upwards of 4ms per frame which isn't a giant leap forward, but it just may be enough to make a difference for you.[/p][p][/p][h3]IL2CPP Branch[/h3][p]To further improve performance, we have built an alternate client using Unity's IL2CPP build process, which converts the game into a native binary. In theory, this should provide significant performance gains. In practice, however, the results can vary considerably depending on several factors - most notably vegetation and point light shadows.[/p][p]Earlier this month we deployed a QA build using this tech but did not get enough feedback for us to make a call on if we should move forward with this tech as the primary build. We would ask that you try playing with the alternate IL2CPP build this month and report any issues you might encounter. If something game breaking comes up you can always swap back to the default branch.[/p][p][/p][p]To swap to this branch right click on Embers Adrift in your Steam library and select "Properties":[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320885/ac905ccea80bc9cf88260acfb526998d01870d54.png"][/img][/p][p]Next select "Betas" in the left hand column and you should see a menu on the right named "Beta Participation". In this dropdown you should see an entry called "live_il2cpp - experimental IL2CPP builds" - select this and you are good to go![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320885/ccc8594450b5ef27a45af1d221202c9fdbfca0aa.png"][/img][/p][p]To swap back to non-IL2CPP builds simply change this dropdown to "None". And just to reiterate - our goal is to make the default IL2CPP so any and all feedback you can provide on these builds would be extremely helpful.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Note that this is a LIVE build -meaning that this branch connects to the LIVE server.[/i][/p]

[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Resource nodes now have abbreviated overhead names.
[*]Ability line-of-sight checks are now cached to avoid multiple identical raycasts per frame.
[*]Added the "/discord" chat command to open our Discord invite link.
[*]Added basic armor and weapons to Newhaven Valley merchants.

[*]Wolves may now howl.

[*]Warden ability Venom Shock: updated the alchemy tooltip text description to be named "Ember Shock" and that it deals Ember damage specifically with alchemy. 
[/list]

[h2]NPC Execution Visibility Improvements[/h2]
To improve the visibility of NPC ability executions we have started to add corresponding visual effects. This first pass touches all control-based effects (Confuse, Root, Snare, Stun, Daze) which should make it easier to interrupt pesky NPCs with a non-resisted Stun, Daze, or Fear. A number of these abilities will also use new unique animations.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gsdYlYl.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2IkAJO6.gif[/img]

We will continue to add NPC VFX where appropriate in future patches. In the mean time, feedback on the current implementations is welcome!

[h2]Engine Upgrade to Unity 6[/h2]
Both the game client and server are now running on Unity 6. This update brings performance improvements, bug fixes, and makes a number of new tech tools available.

The first new tech we are utilizing is a revamp of the dynamic resolution options available in our graphics settings. Previously, we offered a "Resolution Scale" slider (which was AMD's-FSR1), and DLSS for those with supported Nvidia cards. We are now able to offer the following three options:
[list]
[*][b]STP[/b] (Spatial-Temporal Post-Processing): this is Unity's platform agnostic frame-gen solution that works on Windows, MacOS, and Linux with any current hardware.
[*][b]FSR2[/b] (AMD's FidelityFX Super Resolution 2): this is AMD's frame-gen solution that works on Windows and does NOT require an AMD graphics card.
[*][b]DLSS[/b] (Nvidia's Deep Learning Super Sampling): this is Nvidia's frame-gen solution that works on Windows with compatible Nvidia hardware.
[/list]
Each has a quality dropdown which allows you adjust the upscaling towards higher image quality or faster performance. Each technique offers something a little different and performance benefits will vary from machine to machine. We encourage you to tinker with these settings to find what best works for you.

In addition to the above changes, Unity 6 should yield slightly better performance all around. More new tools we will be investigating in the coming weeks to further improve performance.

[h2]Payment Issues Update[/h2]
As mentioned in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3336530/view/510707115067703902]this post[/url], we are continuing to work with Steam to resolve back-end issues related to subscription payments. However, due to the ongoing delays, we’ve decided to transition away from monthly subscriptions and instead offer blocks of perk time for purchase. This change will give us greater control and allow us to address any future issues more quickly and efficiently.

When this new system goes live, any un-refunded subscription payments will be converted into equivalent game time. This change requires some development work. In the meantime, we will continue to provide free subscription perks to all users who log in through Steam.

notes.title: Unity 6 lands on the testing server!
notes.content:
After hours of reimporting textures, compiling shaders, and working through errors we finally have Unity 6 clients ready for testing! Engine upgrades are always a pain in the neck and typically introduce random bugs; that is where you come in!

First you will need to switch Embers Adrift on steam to the "development" branch. This can be done by right clicking on Embers Adrift in your Steam library -> Properties -> Betas -> Beta Participation dropdown select "development". 

[i]Note that this will patch your game to the latest QA client - and in this particular case download is a decent size due to the engine upgrade (many files have changed). Once live and dev are on the same engine version then this difference will typically be much smaller. To swap back to live you follow the same procedure outlined above but select "None" in the betas dropdown.[/i]


[h3]Changes[/h3]
This is primarily a technical update and requires testing of all gameplay elements to validate that everything works as it did previously. However, this upgrade provides us with a few new tools that we have started to experiment with. 

The first change we are testing is a revamp of the dynamic resolution options available in graphics settings. Previously, we offered a "Resolution Scale" slider (which was AMD's-FSR1), and DLSS for those with supported Nvidia cards. We are now able to offer the following three options:
[list]
[*][b]STP[/b] (Spatial-Temporal Post-Processing): this is Unity's platform agnostic frame-gen solution that works on Windows, MacOS, and Linux with any current hardware.
[*][b]FSR2[/b] (AMD's FidelityFX Super Resolution 2): this is AMD's frame-gen solution that works on Windows and does NOT require an AMD graphics card.
[*][b]DLSS[/b] (Nvidia's Deep Learning Super Sampling): this is Nvidia's frame-gen solution that works on Windows with compatible Nvidia hardware.
[/list]
Each has a quality dropdown which allows you adjust the upscaling towards higher image quality or faster performance.

We are considering enabling STP by default for new players to smooth things out and make a better first impression - but we need to hear from you all first! How does STP run on your machine? How does STP compare to FSR2 and DLSS? Do you think that we should enable STP by default for new players? Please join the discord and drop us a line in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/168028734039916544/1075841004449579128]#qa channel [/url]with your thoughts and experience!

In addition to the above changes Unity 6 [i]should[/i] yield slightly better performance all around. There are some additional new tools in Unity 6 that we will be investigating in the coming weeks to improve performance further.

We have some fun content and features planned for this month so stay tuned for further updates! And no, it's not GP2 yet (although we are getting much closer!).

[i][strike]NOTE that Unity 6 builds currently only exist for Windows & MacOS. Linux is running a little behind but hopefully will be ready soon.[/strike] 
A Unity 6 Linux build should be available now!
[/i]

notes.title: EmbersAdrift.com Account Linking
notes.content:
For those of you who have previously purchased the game on EmbersAdrift.com we have reserved a Steam key just for you! Following these instructions will allow you to access your characters with your Steam credentials. Please follow steps 1, 2, 3, and 4.

If you had been playing for free before our transition to Steam but have never purchased the game, you will first need to purchase the game here on Steam before following the instructions below to access your current characters. Once purchased please follow steps 1, 2, and 4.

If you run into any issues during this process please reach out to us on Discord in the #embers-help channel!

[h2]Step 1: Link your forum account to your steam account[/h2]
(you may have already performed this step as it has been available for a few months now)

Open up your [url=https://www.embersadrift.com/Account]EmbersAdrift.com account page[/url]. Here you should see a new option called "Link My Steam Account"
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/200be374fd12a5b8fbccb567279eb4744cc9801d.jpg[/img]
This will show a modal popup with a button to "Link My Forum Account"
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/77c21e45a4209747ac71ff2195e5e98a67ad550b.jpg[/img]
Clicking this button will take you to [url=https://forums.embersadrift.com/index.php?threads/steam-keys-and-account-linking.5981/#:~:text=your%20forum%20account%20preferences%20%22Connected%20Accounts%22%20option]your forum account preferences "Connected Accounts" option[/url].
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/91d86acc69bb0d845bab016bf6af021001724f09.jpg[/img]
Click the "Associate with Steam" button which will take you to the following Steam webpage
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/874952f8c828b2abfd09126b250563bf1115f716.png[/img]
Sign in here to associate your Steam ID to your forum account. Our back-end needs this information for the next step.

[h2]Step 2: Permanently link your EmbersAdrift account to your Steam Account[/h2]
Return to your account page and once again click the "Link My Forum Account" button mentioned above. You should be shown the new modal:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/be1ec26e71f745a07797ccb50f564bae90596cc8.jpg[/img]
Clicking the "Link My Embers Account" will establish a permanent link for the associated Steam ID to your EmbersAdrift forum account. This step allows you to access your forum-account characters with your Steam credentials.

[h2]Step 3: Redeem your Steam key (if you have previously purchased the game on EmbersAdrift.com)[/h2]
If you have previously purchased the game your account should now show the following
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/adddb55b20bc3b4b5aa7addd63842d8ab4bd8bd5.jpg[/img]
Clicking "Redeem Steam Key" you should get a new modal
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/97a188e8ec550f5b5b0ceafa64cb4bb745709bc1.jpg[/img]
Which has a "Redeem on Steam" button to add Embers Adrift to your Steam Library.

[h2]Step 4: Launch the game and login with Steam[/h2]
When launching the game through steam you will be presented with two login options: Steam Login, and Legacy Login
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/b357f63f93dee9b27048c795db418d35d7c408ee.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Steam Login: logs in with your Steam credentials and allows you to purchase a subscription.
[*]Legacy Login: allows you to continue to use your forum username & password. Using this method will not provide any subscriber perks and has been left in place to allow those with multiple accounts to access those characters. Keep in mind that non-subscriber accounts only allow for two active characters. To gain subscriber perks on a secondary account you will need a second Steam account to purchase a subscription.
[/list]
Logging in via Steam will bypass the need for any username/password and instead will use your SteamID to validate ownership and subscription status:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/6f3250ab52699cf8be16769805bb70aabe46d80a.jpg[/img]
